storyCards.headline: Pillowtalk: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Zayn's "Pillowtalk" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Pillowtalk" (stylised in all caps) is the debut solo single by English singer-songwriter Zayn Malik, from his first solo album Mind of Mine.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.

Pillowtalk was released in 2016.
